title: Dependency Sherpa: Onboarding Lanes and Readiness Scorecards for Cross-Team Roadmaps
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: As multiple initiatives ramp up in Q2 we repeatedly see late discoveries of infra/security/design blockers during sprint cutovers. That creates last-minute scope reductions and reactive firefighting. Goal: Build a lightweight 'Dependency Sherpa' pattern - a set of onboarding lanes + per-initiative readiness scorecards that teams (Eng/Design/Security/Infra/PM) update each cycle to provide an early, quantified signal for release gating. The Sherpa should be low-friction (spreadsheet + small console view initially) and integrate into existing cadence (cycle planning, pre-cutover check). Outcomes: 1) surface top-10 cross-team blockers at least 3 weeks before release windows, 2) reduce last-minute rollback/scope-cut incidents by 40% vs baseline, 3) provide a repeatable handoff artifact for on-call and SRE runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard template available and editable by all teams (PM/Eng/Design/Security/Infra)
Automatic aggregation view that shows readiness buckets (Green/Yellow/Red) per initiative
Onboarding lanes documented and linked in the Console runbook with ownership for each lane
Integration with weekly roadmap sync: readiness snapshot exported to meeting agenda automatically
Pilot with 3 initiatives across Eng/Design/Security with retrospective showing at least one early mitigation enabled by the Sherpa flow
tasks: Draft scorecard fields and scoring rubric (owner: PM)
Design lightweight UI mock for Console snapshot (owner: Design)
Define infra and security checklist items (owner: Infra/Security)
Implement Sheets-backed aggregator and webhook to Console (owner: Eng)
Run pilot with 3 initiatives during Cycle 2026-W12 (owner: PM)
Collect pilot metrics and iterate scoring thresholds (owner: PM + Eng)
Create runbook entry for pre-cutover gating and escalation paths (owner: SRE/Infra)
notes: Design trade-offs: keep initial scorecard <= 8 fields to avoid adoption friction. We debated a full Console feature vs Sheets-backed MVP; decided MVP first to validate cadence. Links: Confluence spec https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RR/Dependency+Sherpa, initial mockup https://drive.google.com/mockup/dep-sherpa, prototype aggregator PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2147. Escalation playbook draft: https://docs.incidents/redwood/dependency-sherpa-escalation.md. Considerations: must not add noisy alerts - thresholds should require two-team confirmation before moving to Red. Privacy: scorecards may contain sensitive timeline info; restrict edit access to initiative owners.
